## 4. Quick Run Guide

### Fast (~2 min) — static + unit
```bash
bash tests/validate_framework.sh
python3 -m pytest tests/ -x -q
```

### Medium (~30 min) — + LLM behavioral
```bash
bash tests/validate_framework.sh
python3 -m pytest tests/ -v
bash tests/llm/run.sh
bash tests/infrastructure/run.sh
```

### Full (~2 hr) — + scenarios
```bash
bash tests/validate_framework.sh
python3 -m pytest tests/ -v
bash tests/llm/run.sh
bash tests/infrastructure/run.sh
python3 .agentic/lib/auto/framework_verify.py --all
```
